note: The thirteen FORGE actions (design doc section 4). Legality predicates are implemented in forge.core.actions and named here; caps appear in exactly one row each.

actions.name: COMMIT
actions.description: Phase 0 only (turns 1-3). Register your convention answers for the opening menu slots, sealed until the build opens, then public. One per seat per episode.

slots.description: Map slot_id -> chosen value, covering exactly the opening menu slots.

actions.name: READ
actions.description: Load a file into your open-file register (capacity 6, least-recently-read evicted; open files always render current content). Open files render in your panel.

actions.name: WRITE
actions.description: Replace a file whole (at most 80 lines, 10 files total). SPEC.md, SPEC_ADDENDUM.md, and tests_public.py are engine artifacts and illegal targets.

actions.name: RUN
actions.description: Execute the public suite on the workspace. Costs 1 shared run credit. Results render for everyone.

actions.name: PROBE
actions.description: QA only. Costs 1 probe credit. Returns pass/fail for one hidden test on the current workspace, to QA alone.

actions.name: RELEASE
actions.description: Consume a release token; snapshot the workspace as the graded candidate. The last release is the graded artifact.

actions.name: PROPOSE_IFACE
actions.description: Open an interface contract: at most 2 bound slot values and 2 obligations, 2 or 3 named parties including you. Locks when every other named party agrees; lapses if unagreed after min(6, D - turn) turns.

actions.name: AGREE
actions.description: Accept a live contract you are named in (the proposer's standing is implicit in proposing).

actions.name: REPORT
actions.description: Broadcast 1-3 structured status claims. Scope: a public test id, 'all-public', or {path, task_id}; verdict: pass, fail, or done. The engine grades each claim true or false against actual state.

actions.name: QUERY
actions.description: Ask one teammate something (max 40 tokens). The third seat sees that a message was sent and to whom, never its text.

actions.name: INFORM
actions.description: Tell one teammate something (max 40 tokens). The third seat sees that a message was sent and to whom, never its text.

actions.name: REFUSE
actions.description: Decline to act on the situation or mandate.
